title: New position on a line
prompt: Something is at position x, moving at speed. Return where it is after one frame of delta seconds.
signature: func solve(x: float, speed: float, delta: float) -> float:
starter:
func solve(x: float, speed: float, delta: float) -> float:
	return x
hint: Old position plus the distance moved this frame.
solution:
func solve(x: float, speed: float, delta: float) -> float:
	return x + speed * delta
